notes: Pass 1: the pricing page (key e357b5628f55fda9) answered HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare block page, the only blocked answer from www.pipedrive.com. The knowledge-base article settles that revenue forecasting starts at Growth (C13). C23 codes "built by salespeople" as a founding claim (the about page states the co-founders were salespeople); a reviewer may prefer to treat it as positioning. Generic phrases such as "robust marketplace integrations", "built-in sales assistant", "transparent pricing with no hidden fees" and hedged lines ("Add-ons can raise cost") were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct): the pricing page was read once in a real browser. It shows monthly or annual billing (save up to 42%), four plans with annual prices (Lite US$14, Growth US$39, Premium US$59, Ultimate US$79 per seat per month), five priced add-ons and the 14-day trial; feature lists sit behind 'See all features' and monthly-billing prices are not in the snapshot. Re-classed to true: C01, C02, C03, C04, C07, C09, C10. Re-classed to wrong: C08 (the Essential/Advanced/Professional/Power/Enterprise lineup; the page lists four other plans, and no Pipedrive page dates a rename, so wrong rather than stale). For its cause, six cited pages of crm|5|Claude|3 were checked: two already read for hubspot-crm (pipelinecrm.com, sybill.ai) and four read once now (vendorbenchmark.com carries the sentence; casrai.org, layer3labs.io and salesflare do not state the five tiers as current). Splits under the guide: C26 (four plans, true) from C11 (2026 dating, unverifiable), and C25 (Growth automates follow-ups, true) from C14, whose claim text was narrowed to email sync and the other listed features. Added: C24 ($24 starting price, a table cell, unverifiable for want of monthly prices). Reviewer: look first at C08 (wrong on the lineup) and C06 and C07, where the snapshot's annual-only prices decide the class.
